title: A task of the Proof-of-Done benchmark corpus (tasks/<id>/task.yml), version 1
description: The shape of task.yml after it is read as YAML (the strict subset of DATGOLD-HUB/lib/proof/yaml-subset.mjs). corpus/tools/load.mjs checks this schema and then the rules that a schema cannot say: the marker contract at the end of the prompt, exactly one repository source, allowed_paths inside the repository, the id equal to the folder name, no hidden characters, the files of the task folder and their hashes (corpus/README.md). x-code names the refusal code the loader reports.

version.description: the format version, exactly 1 (a plain number, not quoted)

title.description: one line of text, 1 to 200 characters

prompt.description: the text every agent receives, ending with the marker contract (corpus/README.md)

repo.description: a mapping with exactly one of `git` and `tarball`

url.description: an https:// URL without user name, password, query or fragment

tarball.description: a mapping with `file` (in the task folder) and its `sha256`

setup.description: a list of up to 50 commands

hidden_tests.description: a mapping with the `archive` file name and its `sha256`

allowed_paths.description: a list of 1 to 100 relative paths or globs

items.description: a relative path or glob of 1 to 400 characters

limits.description: a mapping with `wall_seconds` and optionally `max_turns` and `max_cost_cents`

max_turns.description: a whole number of agent turns

max_cost_cents.description: a whole number of US cents

id.description: a safe folder name: 1 to 64 lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, starting and ending with a letter or digit

commit.description: a full commit id, 40 or 64 lower-case hex digits (a branch, a tag or a short id can move)

fileName.description: a plain file name in the task folder: letters, digits, _, - and inner dots, no folder

tag.description: a tag: 1 to 32 lower-case letters, digits and hyphens
